entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these awful cycling shoes I bought. They're complete junk and I want my money back immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

Are you kidding me? They're shoes! They gave me massive blisters after a single ride. The cleats feel like they're going to snap off. This is a defective product and your company should be ashamed. I want a full refund, not a runaround.

I certainly understand your frustration. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can absolutely check on the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?

Look, it's order 8675309. Don't waste my time. If you can't authorize this, get me a manager right now. I'm one click away from posting a review about these terrible shoes on every website I can find.
Thank you for that, one moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order was delivered 25 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy for you.
There's nothing to confirm! Just process the return! This is unbelievable.

I appreciate your patience. And you're right. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now. There's no problem at all.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? You'll issue the full refund?

Yes, of course. I've just authorized the return. I'm sending an email to you as we speak with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay. A prepaid label. That's fine. Just make sure that refund goes through quickly.
It will be processed promptly upon receipt. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
